title: tui: the board as the first screen, behind the tui feature, from bare foam
body: ratatui and crossterm behind the tui feature. One screen with what foam board shows: milestones, in progress, ready, blocked and the recent log, from one Store::load, with a selection cursor and q to quit. Bare foam opens it when stdin and stdout are terminals. Rows render through their own spans for now; fold into render.rs once it is clear what repeats.
